description: HYBRID parallel FFN: each block's dense FFN is AUGMENTED (not replaced) with a second parallel FastMultiHeadLUT path on the same LayerNorm'd input, outputs SUMMED into the residual -- x = x + mlp(h) + fastmhl(h), h = ln2(x). Path A = the exact vanilla dense FFN (Linear 384->1536 -> GELU -> Linear 1536->384). Path B = a PLAIN fixed-anchor-pair FastMultiHeadLut (classic FastMHL, sign-test addressing -- NOT HyperplaneMHL / no learned hyperplane addressing) with n_heads=1, n_outputs=384, NAP=6, tph=256 (matched to the proven exp007-scale 'rich' FastMHL geometry), hard forward, fp32 (use_bf16=False, matching the fp32 model), near-zero table init (1e-3) so the block == vanilla FFN at init and the LUT path grows only if it helps; per-layer anchor/init seed = 1000 + layer_idx. Gradients flow through BOTH paths simultaneously. MATCHED 4096-step A/B against exp032 (byte-identical everything else: MinimalGPT+RoPE, d384/6L/6H/seq512, device_bs 48, total_bs 24576, n_steps 4096, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, eval_every 200, seed 1, vocab 32768, same data). ONLY optimizer deviation: the new LUT-table weights are routed to the NO-weight-decay AdamW group (project lesson: LUT tables take no wd); all dense-path params grouped exactly as exp032. Compare final val_bpb against exp032's 1.39371.
